inputs.note: CFS spike B11: stale checkout test. Not a real order.

B11.expected: Record the price actually charged after the draft changes while checkout is open
notes: Checkout lost the override and showed the catalogue price of 999.99, while the draft in admin was 1179.97.
Pay now produced no visible response. Draft remains OPEN with no order.
After the second Pay now click the page returned to the top with no visible message and no order exists.
Browser tools recorded no console messages or network requests, so the cause of the stalled payment is unknown. Whether Shopify would accept 999.99 is unproven.
B11b: opening the same draft link fresh showed the updated 1179.97, so the base-price fallback affected only the checkout already open when the draft changed.
